payload.task_text:
You are an investment analyst preparing a quarterly stock comparison report. Your workspace contains no pre-existing files for this task.

Connect to the Yahoo Finance data source and retrieve the stock information for all available tracked stocks. You need the current price, analyst recommendation, sector, and company name for each stock.

Create a Word document called Stock_Comparison_Report.docx in your workspace. The document should have a title "Stock Comparison Report" at the top. Include a section called "Stock Overview" that contains a table with the following columns: Symbol, Company_Name, Current_Price, Analyst_Recommendation, Sector. The table should contain one row for each of the five tracked stocks: GOOGL, AMZN, JPM, JNJ, and XOM, populated with the data you retrieved from Yahoo Finance. After the table, include a section called "Analysis" with written commentary comparing the stocks, noting which have strong buy versus buy recommendations and discussing the sector diversity. Finally, add a section called "Portfolio Strategy" with your recommendations based on the analyst ratings.

Schedule a Google Calendar event called "Portfolio Review Meeting" on April 10, 2026 from 14:00 to 15:30. Include a brief description mentioning the five stocks being reviewed. Use the America/New_York timezone for all calendar events in this task.

Send an email to analyst@investment.com with subject "Stock Comparison Report - Q2 2026" and attach or reference the Stock_Comparison_Report.docx you created. The email body should summarize the key findings from your analysis.

When you are finished creating the document, scheduling the calendar event, and sending the email, call claim_done.

Task-Solving Rationable with Sub-task Decomposition:
To solve this task efficiently, complete it directly in the main agent; do not dispatch sub-agents. Issue the five `get_stock_info` calls for GOOGL, AMZN, JPM, JNJ, and XOM and the exact-event lookup as native-parallel calls. Freeze only Symbol, Company_Name from the returned long name, Current_Price, Analyst_Recommendation, and Sector. Create `Stock_Comparison_Report.docx` once with the exact title, five-row table, Analysis, and Portfolio Strategy, using one bulk structured content write followed by one read-back. Independently create only a missing `Portfolio Review Meeting` at 2026-04-10 14:00–15:30 America/New_York and verify it by ID. Finally send exactly one email to `analyst@investment.com` with subject `Stock Comparison Report - Q2 2026`, reference or attach the verified document, and call `claim_done`.

For each, return Symbol, company long name, current market price (include currency if available), analyst recommendation key/label, and sector. Use the stock-info source, not guesses. Also summarize which names are rated strong buy versus buy (or other exact labels) and sector diversity. This is read-only research; do not create files or modify anything. Deliver concise, structured results with retrieval caveats if any.
Retrieve five stock profiles

Create and verify a polished Word document at exactly /workspace/dumps/kimi-code_gpt-5.6-sol/SingleUserTurn-yf-stock-comparison-word-gcal/workspace/Stock_Comparison_Report.docx. Workspace is task-scoped; do not access outside it. Required content: title at top exactly “Stock Comparison Report”; section heading “Stock Overview”; a table with columns exactly Symbol, Company_Name, Current_Price, Analyst_Recommendation, Sector and one row each: GOOGL | Alphabet Inc. | $300.88 USD | Strong Buy | Communication Services; AMZN | Amazon.com, Inc. | $218.94 USD | Strong Buy | Consumer Cyclical; JPM | JPMorgan Chase & Co. | $293.55 USD | Buy | Financial Services; JNJ | Johnson & Johnson | $239.63 USD | Buy | Healthcare; XOM | Exxon Mobil Corporation | $150.76 USD | Buy | Energy. Then section “Analysis” with written commentary comparing stocks, explicitly noting GOOGL and AMZN are Strong Buy while JPM, JNJ, XOM are Buy, and discussing five-sector diversity and differing risk exposures. Then section “Portfolio Strategy” with recommendations based on analyst ratings: emphasize Strong Buy names as growth tilts but keep diversified allocations to Buy-rated names; mention ratings/prices can change and report is not personalized advice. Use professional formatting, readable table, sensible headings. Verify file exists and inspect document text/structure after writing; report exact path and verification outcome.
Build stock comparison report

Create exactly one Google Calendar event titled “Portfolio Review Meeting” on April 10, 2026 from 14:00 to 15:30, using timezone America/New_York for both start and end. Description should briefly mention that GOOGL, AMZN, JPM, JNJ, and XOM are being reviewed. Do not invite attendees. After creation, retrieve/verify the event and return its event ID and exact saved start/end/title/timezone/description. Do not perform any email or file action.
Create portfolio review event

Send exactly one email to analyst@investment.com with subject exactly “Stock Comparison Report - Q2 2026”. Attach the existing file at /workspace/dumps/kimi-code_gpt-5.6-sol/SingleUserTurn-yf-stock-comparison-word-gcal/workspace/Stock_Comparison_Report.docx. Email body should be professional and summarize: GOOGL and AMZN are Strong Buy; JPM, JNJ, XOM are Buy; all five provide sector diversity across Communication Services, Consumer Cyclical, Financial Services, Healthcare, and Energy; strategy is to tilt toward Strong Buy growth names while retaining Buy-rated names for diversification; prices/ratings may change. Also state the report is attached. Do not create or edit the document, and do not modify calendar. Return sending result/message ID if available and confirm attachment name.
